newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped below the 1,400-point barrier on Tuesday on rumours of political unrest ahead of elections set for February 3, dealers said.
They said political and economic uncertainty ahead of the polls would keep the market bearish or range-bounded as most major investors would remain on the sidelines.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 13.41 points, or 0.95 percent, to end at 1,395.75. Losers led gainers 154 to 83. Turnover rose to 29.92 million shares from 28.89 million in the previous session.
Faysal Bank fell 0.25 rupees to 21.50 rupees and Adamjee Insurance 5.0 to 87. Dewan Salman Fibre fell 2.0 to 30. Hub Power Co fell 0.85 to 32.40.
Pakistan State Oil 3.0 to 287. PTCL rose 0.05 to 27.25. ICI Pakistan fell 0.60 to 18.60 and Fauji Fertilizer 0.50 to 67.25. Lever Brothers fell 9.0 to 650.
